label: Places named in articles that use this word
source: GDELT Web NGrams 3.0 joined to GDELT GKG 2.0 V2Locations (BigQuery)
notes: Counts are distinct English-language articles. An article that names several countries counts once for each, so shares can sum past 100%.
An article reached at several web addresses that differ only after ? or # counts once, when its address carries an article slug.
A place named in an article is not where the article was published or read.

GDELT files some Gaza and West Bank places, and the words Palestinian and Palestine, under Israel's country code. Those, with GDELT's own Gaza Strip and West Bank codes, count as one row: Palestinian territories (code GZWE).
Separate instrument from velocity: never mixed into velocity, percentiles or momentum labels.
site_trim: top 5 countries and top 40 places per word; country labels normalised from GDELT's city names; full record in the toolkit's data/geo/*.full.json
